stem: Which ending result or final point follows “The tag made students think about the next person, not only the rule.”?
options: Things often feel more valuable when people understand what it costs to fix them.
Responsibility can grow when people understand that their action affects someone they may never meet.
If people want future readers to understand today's online world, someone must save it before links break and pages vanish.
I still miss home, but I am beginning to understand why people like camp.
